overview: Schizophrenia is a mental disorder characterized by significant impairments in the way reality is perceived and changes in behaviour, causing considerable disability and affecting all areas of life. It is associated with psychosis, disorganized thinking and behaviour, and negative symptoms. The disorder can be treated with a range of effective care options, and at least one in three people with schizophrenia will be able to fully recover.
symptoms: experiences of influence, control or passivity
restricted experience and expression of emotions
inability to experience interest or pleasure
extreme agitation or slowing of movements
persistent difficulties with cognitive or thinking skills
complications: physical illnesses, such as cardiovascular, metabolic, and infectious diseases
premature death, with an average of 9 years earlier than the general population
key_facts: approximately 23 million people worldwide are affected by schizophrenia
people with schizophrenia die 9 years earlier than the general population
